competences.description: Attacks the enemy to increase the duration of harmful effects (excluding inability effects) granted on the target by 1 turn with a 50% chance and decrease its Attack Power for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: Increases the duration of one or more debuffs on the enemy
The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times. The first hit installs a bomb that detonates after 2 turns with a 90% chance, and the second hit stuns all enemies for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

effets.description: When remaining turns reach 0, the bomb explodes to deal damage that ignores Defense and stuns for 1 turn. The damage is affected by the caster's Attack Power, and the chance of stunning is affected by the caster's Accuracy and the target's Resistance.
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Increases the duration of beneficial effects granted by skills on yourself by 1 turn. Additionally, increases your Attack Power by 100%, up to 300%, and the harmful effect activation rate by 20% for every beneficial effect granted on yourself. However, your HP decreases by 10% if you gain a turn while you are granted with 3 or more beneficial effects. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Increases the duration of a buff by a number of turns.
The target's Attack Power will be increased by 50%.
effets.note: Up to 300%, for each beneficial effect granted on yourself.
